visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera is positioned at a high angle looking down at a wooden floor next to a grey textured sofa base. Two pairs of adult-sized sneakers (one white with black trim, one white and light grey) are placed neatly. A third, significantly smaller pair of white baby sneakers suddenly appears to the right of the adult shoes. The lighting is soft and even. (2) The scene cuts to a dining area. A large wooden dining table with a bouquet of pink and white flowers in a glass vase is surrounded by four minimalist white chairs. A wooden baby high chair with a white tray suddenly appears in the foreground next to the table. (3) The scene cuts to a white kitchen countertop. Two white mugs with black illustrations (one of a person on a motorcycle, one of a cityscape) and the text 'TAIPEI LAI HAO' are shown. A small green baby sippy cup with a car illustration appears between the two mugs. (4) The scene cuts to a dark wooden surface. Two thick books, one titled 'Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind' and another with gold-foiled Chinese characters, are laid out. A small, colorful baby board book titled 'On the farm' appears in the bottom center. (5) The scene cuts to a light beige fabric armchair. Two pairs of adult knitted mittens (one green/white, one brown/white) are laid out side-by-side. A single, tiny black baby mitten appears in the center between the two pairs.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Object Presence -> Addition of Baby Object -> Repeat Cycle
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle montage aimed at announcing or celebrating the addition of a new baby to a household. By showing adult-sized items (shoes, chairs, cups, books, mittens) and then having a miniature baby version appear in each scene, the video uses visual metaphors to convey how a child has changed and enriched their domestic life, fulfilling the promise of the caption about life becoming 'sweeter'.
